body:
Triage: `needs-user-decision` (feature — expands the public authoring surface, human floor per the standing adjudication boundary), `domain:identity`, type `Feature`. Original request quoted verbatim: 「权限设置应该可以配置实效性，权限在一个时间段之内生效」.

Context the ruling should weigh — the platform already owns a time-validity vocabulary for grants, partially live:
- ADR-0091 declares **grant validity windows**, and `resolveUserAuthzGrants` applies the window to `sys_member`-derived `accessible_org_ids` today (#8802 measures the org-admin role projection as still unfiltered).
- The ADR-0091 D5 recertification columns are declared on both grant tables with no producer or reader (#9046).
- The ADR-0056 authz matrix has no row for the windows at all (#8811).

So the open questions are **scope** (which permission artefacts get an effective-from/effective-until axis: permission-set assignments? sharing rules? object permissions?), **shape** (reuse the ADR-0091 window vocabulary vs minting a second time axis), and **appetite**.

Decision block (four-prism):
- **Platform long-term coherence** — reusing the ADR-0091 window shape on more grant surfaces converges one time axis; a new per-surface validity shape would be a second one to reconcile forever.
- **Measured business pull** — maintainer-filed request; no external user measurement on the card yet.
- **AI-agent error-resistance** — a declared window must be enforced at evaluation time on every surface where it is writable; #9046/#8802 show the declared-but-partially-enforced state this feature would widen if shipped declaration-first. Enforce-with-declare, or don't declare.
- **Startup scope discipline** — new capability surface; the discipline is to scope to the narrowest artefact with real pull and land evaluation-side enforcement in the same change.

Recommendation: if approved, start with time-bounded **permission-set assignments** reusing the ADR-0091 window keys, enforcement measured in the same PR; defer the wider surfaces until something pulls.

This comment is from the triage seat Routine — session `session_01GmAinGNjquRHcvG8mEStYe`.

- **Scope**: time-bounded **permission-set assignments** only (effective-from / effective-until), **reusing the ADR-0091 grant-validity-window vocabulary** — ⛔ no second time axis. Wider surfaces (sharing rules, object permissions) wait for measured pull.
- **Enforce-with-declare**: the window is enforced at evaluation time **in the same PR** that declares it — never declaration-first (the ADR-0049 dead-surface shape).
- **Precondition / same program**: #8802 (org-admin role projection still unfiltered by the existing windows) is fixed first or in the same batch, so the window axis is not widened while half-enforced.

**Hold record (`pm:on-hold`, `target:v18`)**: Date 2026-08-17; decision made, scheduled at v18 by the maintainer. Named restart condition: the v18 planning window opens — this card re-queues with the scope above and carves (identity lane; the assignment-surface declaration is an accept-surface change ⇒ `claude-fable-5` for that slice).

## Half-state patrol disposition (H9) — the hold gets a machine-fireable exit, and a defect is recorded

`domain:services` seat, session `session_0157mMVAq9fjGe2kaSD2aJC8`, round 1.

Patrol anchor #9857 (swept 02:12:33Z) reports **H9**: `pm:on-hold` with no `Restart-when:` in either channel. Confirmed. Supplying the exit:

**Restart-when: the v18 line opens for feature work — measured as: any `target:v18` card in this repo has reached `pm:dispatched`, OR the v17 line has cut its final release. Then this card needs a written body (see below) before it can be graded or dispatched.**

**Restart-touch: `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/`, `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/`** — the permission-evaluation surface a time-bounded grant would land on.

### Why a hold and not the decision inbox

`target:v18` already records the appetite answer ("yes, on the v18 line"), which is a decision **made** — the definition of `pm:on-hold`, as against `needs-user-decision` for a decision still owed. ⛔ Not escalated.

### ⚠️ Recorded defect: this card has no body

The issue carries a title and nothing else — no problem statement, no scenario, no acceptance shape. The title (「权限设置应该可以配置实效性,权限在一个时间段之内生效」) names a real and common requirement (time-bounded permission grants: access that turns on at a date and expires at another — a contractor, a covering approver, a temporary auditor), but a one-line title is **not dispatchable and not rulable**:

- it does not say whether the window sits on the **grant** (this user's permission set expires) or on the **permission set itself** (this set is only live in Q4);
- it does not say what happens to work in flight when the window closes mid-session;
- it does not say whether expiry is evaluated at grant-read time or swept.

⇒ Whoever opens the v18 line on this card should write those three answers into the body first, or send it to the decision box. ⛔ It must not be dispatched as it stands: a dev would silently pick one of the three shapes, in code, where nobody reviews it as a decision.

⛔ Deliberately **not** rewriting the body myself — an execution seat does not author another filer's scope, and inventing a spec here would launder my guess into the record as if it were the requirement.

The same defect is filed as #10982 ("sys_member's role projection ignores the ADR-0091 validity window while accessible_org_ids honours it"), which is closed `completed`. The claimant confirms the window filter on `main` before the PR.

## Card face (from the ruling, 「9272 放到 v18开发」)
- **Scope:** time-bounded **permission-set assignments** only (effective-from / effective-until), reusing ADR-0091's grant-validity-window vocabulary. ⛔ No second time axis. Sharing rules and object permissions wait for measured pull.
- **The three questions the patrol asked:**
  1. **Where the window sits:** on the assignment (the grant), not on the permission set.
  2. **When expiry is evaluated:** at every permission evaluation (read time), as the ruling's enforce-with-declare requires. ⛔ No sweep job.
  3. **Work in flight** (derived): the first evaluation after the window closes denies. No other session effect.
- **Enforce-with-declare:** the window is declared and enforced in one PR. ⛔ Never declaration-first.
- **Pins:**
  - an assignment before its effective-from grants nothing;
  - inside the window it grants;
  - after its effective-until it grants nothing at the next evaluation;
  - an assignment without a window is unchanged (control);
  - the declaring surface refuses effective-until earlier than effective-from (derived).
- `Clause-②: yes` (new fields on the assignment surface). A contract review is owed at the PR.
- **The release state:** a breaking change that lands before #22080 is graded `minor`, with its BREAKING banner and ADR-0087 disposition. After #22080 it is graded `major`. ⛔ #21988 is not merged.

**Executes the card face** (triage `6038966446`, from the maintainer's ruling `5315732575`): time-bounded permission-set assignments on ADR-0091's window vocabulary, enforced at every evaluation. ⛔ No second time axis.

**The seat's reading at claim, from source on `origin/main` `54c3ce10` (the dev measures each first):**
- The declaration half is already on `main`. `sys_user_permission_set` declares `valid_from` / `valid_until` (ADR-0091 D1), and the resolver drops a grant outside its window through `isGrantActive` at resolution time (D2). Triage's "`Clause-②: yes` (new fields on the assignment surface)" rests on fields that already exist. So no field is added.
- What the card face still lacks: (1) the five pins, end to end on a permission-set assignment; (2) the authoring surface: the user page's permission-set list (`platform-objects` `sys-user.page.ts`) shows no window, and its Add binds only the set; (3) the derived refusal of a window whose end is not after its start.

File surface:
- **`packages/plugins/plugin-security`:** the inverted-window refusal on `sys_user_permission_set` writes. The lead is a declared validation on `objects/sys-user-permission-set.object.ts` if the engine enforces one on every write path; otherwise one engine hook module, plus at most one wiring line in `security-plugin.ts` (objectstack-ai/objectstack#15207 is closed, so its hold is released). Its tests.
- **`packages/platform-objects/src/pages/sys-user.page.ts`:** the permission-set related list shows the window, and the window is settable where the page's components allow it.
- **`packages/qa/dogfood`:** one end-to-end pin file for the five card-face pins.
- **One changeset per touched published package.**

- Seat append, 2026-10-08T22:47Z, from the dev report (PR #22364): H3 took the declared shape. `validity_window_order` is a `cross_field` validation in `objects/sys-user-permission-set.object.ts`, with no hook and no `security-plugin.ts` line. Its message regenerates `plugin-security`'s translation bundles (`translations/*.objects.generated.ts` and the source-hash companions, via `check-i18n-bundles --write`). `platform-objects` gains one page pin test (`src/pages/sys-user-permission-set-window-columns.test.ts`).

Exclusions:
- ⛔ No `packages/core` (`resolve-authz-context.ts`, `grant-validity.ts`; `domain:engine`). Enforcement is already there; existing pins are cited, not rewritten.
- ⛔ No `packages/spec`. ⛔ No new field. ⛔ No sweep job.
- ⛔ `sys_user_position` and other grant surfaces are out of scope (the ruling: "wait for measured pull").
- ⛔ No change to objectstack-ai/objectstack#15196's name-column readers (PR #22352, in the merge queue).

Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (`dispatch-gates --tier`: no path-derived mandate; default tier). One contract-tier review is owed (triage), by the seat after the dev reports.
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
- The one accept-set change refuses a write that used to land: an assignment whose `valid_until` is not after its `valid_from`. Today such a grant lands and never confers anything. No field and no answer is added.
Responsibility: `this repository's own code: the assignment surface lets an administrator neither see nor set the window that resolution already enforces, and accepts a window that can never be active | none: no write-time check judges the window's order | administrators granting a permission set for a period (a contractor, a covering approver, a temporary auditor)`

- objectstack-ai/objectstack#5082's index (PR #22103) is merged. objectstack-ai/objectstack#15207 is closed.
